testcase.name: Scenario: Close and restore the drawing browser from its tab area: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/workspace-layout/workspace-layout.feature:238:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Close and restore the drawing browser from its tab area ✔ Given a drawing is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And its model browser is docked on the left ✔ When the user selects the browser tab's close control ✔ Then the browser tree is hidden ✔ And the drawing occupies the space previously used by the browser ✔ And a plus control remains at the upper left of the workspace ✔ When the user opens the plus control ✔ Then the panel list offers Model Browser ✔ When the user selects Model Browser ✔ Then the browser returns to the left ✔ And it displays the drawing resources and sheet tree
